channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Volunteers bury underwear to test soil health
item.description: Over 1,000 people buried cotton underwear across Switzerland to help scientists gauge soil activity. Faster fabric decay indicates healthier soil.

item.title: Hidden ice reservoir discovered beneath Utah mountains
item.description: Researchers using gravity measurements found a large ice deposit under Mount Timpanogos, far more than surface observations suggest.

item.title: All 212 plant-based meat alternatives tested contained fungal toxins
item.description: A UK study found that every one of 212 plant-based meat alternatives and drinks contained at least one naturally occurring fungal toxin, though levels varied.

item.title: Human presence alters wildlife movement as much as roads, study finds
item.description: Tracking 4,500 animals revealed that human presence can reshape wildlife movement and habitats, sometimes as strongly as infrastructure like roads.
